method: Standalone SVG compositor: neutral image clipped by silhouette, color overlay using multiply blend within region mask. Recipe is NOT a project.json renderer field.

review.scope: Source images inspected at generated resolution; supporting masks and two palette demonstrations inspected at approximately 274px width on light/dark and blue/red backgrounds. Native-size final scene inspection still required.
